description: This is a Python source file that implements a class SpendLogCleanup responsible for cleaning up old spend logs from a database. It manages log deletion based on retention periods, uses a locking mechanism to prevent concurrent cleanups in multi-pod deployments, and performs batch deletions asynchronously.
